subject.title: [Feature]: Per-session activity state (busy/idle + awaiting_user, awaiting_subagent) via gateway API + WS statechange

question: What canonical public Gateway activity and attention contract should OpenClaw expose for per-session busy, waiting, stale-run, and child-session state?
rationale: The request adds public RPC/event semantics and durability rules across Gateway, sessions, Control UI, and future watchdogs; current main has only coarse active-run flags and open PRs disagree on scope.

options.title: Approve canonical activity contract
options.body: Define `sessions.activity.*`, the statechange event, versioning, stale-run handling, attention durability, child rollup, and access rules before merging implementation work.

options.title: Narrow to UI/status slices
options.body: Allow smaller stale/status or Control UI progress PRs to land while keeping the broader activity API open for later design.

options.title: Defer public surface
options.body: Keep using `sessions.list` coarse `hasActiveRun` signals until maintainers are ready to own a broader Gateway API contract.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical activity contract
recommendation.body: Define `sessions.activity.*`, the statechange event, versioning, stale-run handling, attention durability, child rollup, and access rules before merging implementation work.
